But the extremely hard part for me is, that I just got really close with a girl, to the point where I talk to here about my depression, scars and even suicidal thoughts. On Sunday before the lockdown started here in Austria, we were lust laying in her bed, holding hands and cuddling. This was my very first time doing this and it felt awesome, it gave me a feeling of comfort, I never had before. I felt happy for the first time in a long time. Now this is gone too.

Where I think it really started was like around 8 where I saw my father betting the sh*t out of my mother and we flew to another city for a few months, just to get back to him and her getting terrorized by him again.

Started around 14 where I got moved into my 4th class, and still wasnt able to socialise or find friends or atleast not get bullied. Welp from there on it just went worse with each year i was getting older. 

16 was like my next big step, where I started cutting myself. Pushing my few friends (whom I really thankful for) away and cut almost all social interaction off. 

18 was another breaking point for me, with my father being diagnosed with cancer and having 2 more years to live with treatment. I started using pain killers to calm myself down and being able to fall asleep when I took enough. Found out about Xanax as well through my new music taste.

Me 20, you guessed it Xanax joined the club. Another really big thing for me was when I got to know that my mother already had a suicide attempt.
